input.quote: the matter shall be referred to the Management Committee which shall either resolve the matter or determine the method, such as arbitration, by which the matter should be resolved. This procedure shall be the sole and exclusive remedy for any dispute which may arise under this Agreement between or among the Parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no choice of law at all: Paragraph 27.2 affirmatively directs that facts pointing to any particular national law be disregarded, and Paragraph 25 only requires compliance with applicable laws. Dispute resolution is committed to the Management Committee, which may itself impose arbitration (Paragraph 20 contemplates arbitration in a country other than a Party's own), and that procedure is the "sole and exclusive remedy" — so no court forum exists. This fails both the preferred and fallback checklists (no accepted governing law; committee-determined, potentially foreign arbitration displacing courts). We therefore replaced Paragraph 27.2 with New York law and exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County (temporary injunctive relief reserved elsewhere), and conformed the 27.1 exclusivity/arbitration mechanic so it no longer contradicts the court forum. Delaware, California, or England and Wales with the courts of London would be acceptable fallbacks.

proposal.summary: Add New York governing law and exclusive New York County court venue, and conform the dispute mechanic that made Management Committee referral (possibly arbitration) the sole and exclusive remedy.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no governing law and makes Management Committee referral (which may impose arbitration) the sole and exclusive remedy, so we have substituted our preferred position: New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, reserving only temporary injunctive relief elsewhere. ops.newText: the matter shall be referred to the Management Committee which shall endeavour to resolve the matter. If the Management Committee does not resolve the matter, the dispute shall be determined in accordance with Paragraph 27.2.

ops.oldText: 27.2 If any difference shall arise between or among the Parties or any of them in respect of the interpretation or effect of this Agreement or any part or provision thereof or their rights and obligations thereunder, and by reasons thereof there shall arise the need to decide the question by what municipal or national law this Agreement or any part or provision thereof is governed, the following facts shall be excluded from consideration, namely that this Agreement was made in a particular country and that it may appear by reason of its form, style, language or otherwise to have been drawn preponderantly with reference to a particular system of municipal or national law; the intention of the Parties being that such facts shall be regarded by the Parties and in all courts and tribunals wherever situated as irrelevant to the question aforesaid and to the decision thereof.
ops.newText: 27.2 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York. The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York shall have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits of any dispute arising under this Agreement, provided that any Party may seek temporary injunctive relief in any other court of competent jurisdiction.

mappings.element: New York law governs the Agreement.
